name: Prism the Silver Beam Cat
blurb: Prism, a sleek silver tabby with faint grey stripes and ice-blue eyes, chases the rainbow dots a glass prism casts on the garden wall.

name: Scatter the Dice-Spot Cat
blurb: Scatter, a white shorthair with black spots strewn at random so no two sides match, naps wherever the first falling leaf lands.

name: Flicker the Smoky Dusk Cat
blurb: Flicker, a smoky charcoal cat with a pale silver undercoat and bright gold eyes, sits by the pond at dusk blinking back at glowworms.
